title: Corrected exceptional-set dimension bounds for random S-adic cocycles on Oseledets subspaces containing the unstable bundle
author: Alexander I. Bufetov; Boris Solomyak
work: Hölder regularity for the spectrum of translation flows; Corrigendum to “Hölder regularity for the spectrum of translation flows”
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 8 (2021), publisher version, primary DOI 10.5802/jep.146; official corrigendum identity and author-page assembly are recorded in source_locator, source_components and source_assembly.

source_locator.theorem: Proposition5.4 with official corrected quantifier order
source_locator.correction_scope: For every epsilon1>0 there exist delta0>0 and rho>0; then for almost every a and every delta in(0,delta0), every B>1 and each eligible Oseledets subspace, the dimension bound holds. Proof unchanged according to official author corrigendum.

difficulty_reason: Oseledets estimates and the cited exponential-tail result do not directly bound the exceptional set of parameters uniformly over the frequency interval. The author builds a lattice-prediction scheme, counts its exceptional choices by an entropy estimate, and combines the unstable-projection cover with the complementary Oseledets directions. The corrected order of choosing the parameters is essential to that dimension bound, and the entire authored covering construction remains in the packet.
